CweFindings.Name: Insufficient Logging
CweFindings.Description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.
CweFindings.Explanation: LoginModel.OnPostAsync returns the same error page for failed username/password attempts without recording the authentication failure. Repeated failed login attempts are therefore not logged for monitoring or audit.

CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: The upload handler returns a client-supplied filename in failedUploads.fileName (Index.cshtml.cs:88-92). upload.js interpolates photo.originalFileName into HTML attributes and element text in a template string inserted with insertAdjacentHTML (lines 189-210), and interpolates error values into a string assigned to innerHTML (lines 223-226). A crafted filename can therefore inject markup/script into pages shown to other users.
